title: eat shit & die 133
author: bpatrick
hoverText: It's dangerous the way those other guys say what we say is dangerous
body:
The comic’s green this week – maybe too green. I should have a new Mann’s page later this week. It’s getting to a nice stopping point. Does anyone have any suggestions on what longer storyline I should start updating next?
p.s. I just read Scott Pilgrim 1 and it was pretty damn good.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: I’ve been looking forward to doing the next part of Vivian Blank. That could work.
